'''Shiraya''' was an ancient [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Deity/Legends|goddess]] that was [[Naboo religion|worshipped]] by the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Naboo/Legends|same name]]. She was traditionally depicted as a winged, [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] brandishing a crescent moon-shaped symbol.<ref name="ROSV" /> [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], a prominent [[Politics/Legends|political]] figure on Naboo during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> was a worshipper of Shiraya.<ref name="ROSV" /><ref name="TPMV">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> In [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]], [[Naberrie family/Legends|her family's]] retreat house, Amidala owned<ref name="ROSV" /> at least two<ref name="OSVC">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 28|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 28]]</ref> statues of the goddess. When she was [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen of Naboo]], Amidala sometimes [[Padmé Amidala's wardrobe/Legends|wore]] [[Shiraya fan headdress/Legends|Shiraya fan headdresses]] in her honor.<ref name="TPMV" /> During her tenure as [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]], the former queen moved her statues of Shiraya in the open-air private veranda of [[Naboo Queen (restaurant)|her apartment]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="ROSV" />
